name: Phi-4-mm-inst-asr-turkish
context_scaling: Inherited unchanged from microsoft/Phi-4-multimodal-instruct (config.json max_position_embeddings 131072). This derivative does not publish a context-extension recipe of its own.
notes: ADDED 2026-11-04. A finetune of microsoft/Phi-4-multimodal-instruct, not a new base model: same config.json, same 5.574 parameters (identical tensor set). Recorded as a contender because it publishes benchmark evidence against its own base; the evidence rows below are card-sourced and marked vendor_claim. Licence mit, repo created 2025-02-28.

benchmarks.name: Turkish ASR test WER %
benchmarks.config: Card 'Evaluation Results' bullet list, not a columned table: 'Before Fine-Tuning: WER 127.29' vs 'After Fine-Tuning: WER 47.57' on the same evaluation set (600-hour Turkish dataset). Prompt 'Transcribe the Turkish audio'. Card names no dataset, split, decoding or chunking. Lower is better.

benchmarks.name: Turkish ASR test CER %
benchmarks.config: Same bullet list: 'Before Fine-Tuning: CER 78.22' vs 'After Fine-Tuning: CER 20.52'. Lower is better.
